cves.d: SuperTokens Core is an open source authentication server. From 6.0.0 until 6.0.24, 7.0.23, 8.0.7, 9.0.6, 9.1.6, 9.2.7, 9.3.5, 10.0.8, 10.1.9, 11.0.9, 11.1.4, 11.2.4, 11.3.8, 11.4.8, 12.0.11, 12.1.2, 12.2.1, and 12.3.1, Multitenancy.checkPermissionsForCreateOrUpdate in src/main/java/io/supertokens/multitenancy/Multitenancy.java does not adequately authorize updates to a parent connection URI domain or the base tenant. In a licensed multi-tenant deployment with multiple applications under one non-default connection URI domain and separate api_keys, an attacker holding one application's valid API key can update the parent domain because the CUD-target branch checks the domain without requiring the source application and tenant to be public. Because api_keys is not protected, the attacker can replace the parent key and then sibling application keys, read or modify sibling users, obtain sessions as those users, establish persistence through a sibling dashboard user, and lock out the sibling application's own key. In the advisory's v2 create or update handlers, omitting the optional identifier produces a base-tenant target that skips the permission branches and enterprise-feature gate, allowing changes to firstFactors, required secondary factors, and recipe-enabled flags that affect login integrity and availability. The base-target variant still rejects coreConfig and does not establish key theft. This issue is fixed in versions 6.0.24, 7.0.23, 8.0.7, 9.0.6, 9.1.6, 9.2.7, 9.3.5, 10.0.8, 10.1.9, 11.0.9, 11.1.4, 11.2.4, 11.3.8, 11.4.8, 12.0.11, 12.1.2, 12.2.1, and 12.3.1.

A flaw was found in the rrule validation of schedules in automation controller. Several non-anchored regular expressions with lazy wildcard prefixes are applied to the user-supplied rrule value; when the expected DTSTART/RRULE tokens are absent, validation time grows quadratically with the length of the value. An authenticated user can submit a large token-free rrule through the REST API, including the schedule preview endpoint, which requires no resource-level permissions; validation runs synchronously in the API web worker, so a single such request occupies a worker for an extended time and repeated requests can exhaust the web worker pool, denying access to the API and web UI while the attack is sustained. The impact is limited to availability.

The Android implementation of the Flutter/Dart receive_sharing_intent package, versions 1.4.1 through 1.9.0, contains a path traversal vulnerability in FileDirectory.getDataColumn that allows a malicious co-resident application to write files outside the intended cache directory by supplying a crafted _display_name value from an untrusted ContentProvider. Attackers can use a path-shaped display name ../databases/proof.txt combined with a controlled content stream to write to arbitrary locations within the receiving application's private sandbox under its UID, achieving file overwrite without user interaction.

compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.32.0 until 0.33.0, compose-lint's incomplete remediation for .env secret disclosure checks the 20,000-finding limit before replacing resolved values with their variable references. A pull request can combine a secret-referencing image field with aliased content that produces more than 20,000 findings, causing the early-stop path to emit already graded findings with the resolved secret value in text, JSON, SARIF, and Code Scanning output. Exploitation requires a workflow that writes secrets into the sibling .env and lints untrusted changes, and the run exits 2 unless --allow-partial-coverage is used. This issue is fixed in version 0.33.0.

compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.9.0 until 0.18.0, compose-lint's YAML parser recognizes lone carriage returns and Unicode line separators U+0085, U+2028, and U+2029 as line breaks while fix position conversion counts only newline characters. A pull request can place one of these separators in a quoted value so fix --apply shifts each later edit and deletes the line after the selected target, including an unselected network or other security setting. The resulting Compose file can remain valid, post-edit checks can pass, and the command can report a successful fix even though the dry-run diff was the only place showing the extra deletion. This issue is fixed in version 0.18.0.

OctoPrint provides a web interface for controlling consumer 3D printers. From 2.0.0rc1 until 2.0.0rc7, an authenticated user can supply a crafted default port or baudrate through a connect request to the bundled Serial Connector plugin. OctoPrint persists these values in printerConnection.preferred.parameters.port or printerConnection.preferred.parameters.baudrate and renders them as HTML when another user views the saved connection parameters, allowing script execution in that user's browser and actions within the user's OctoPrint access. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.0rc7.

A weakness has been identified in PipraPay 3.0.0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function hash_hmac of the file pp-content/pp-include/pp-adapter.php of the component pp-token anti-CSRF Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to hard-coded credentials. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.19 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.1 contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code by pushing a crafted serialized job onto the Redis-backed Laravel Horizon queue, which runs without authentication in affected deployments. Laravel's CallQueuedHandler unserializes the job without class restrictions, allowing attackers to instantiate the existing App\\Jobs\\TaskDownloadRun class and invoke an attacker-controlled Artisan command. Attackers can leverage the bundled laravel/tinker package to execute arbitrary PHP and operating system commands as the queue worker's user, write a persistent web shell into the web-served storage/app/public directory, and read database credentials, stored device credentials, and API tokens. Where Redis is not directly reachable, authenticated attackers can deliver the payload through the application by configuring a device target that points at the rConfig server's loopback address.

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by web security and network device ecosystems, characterized by widespread remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and memory corruption flaws. Critical weaknesses impact widely deployed systems including Kubernetes agents, WordPress plugins, MB Connect Line medical infrastructure, and multiple database middleware components, enabling unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges or exfiltrate sensitive data. The recurring patterns of injection attacks, improper authorization controls, and insecure credential handling underscore systemic deficiencies in input validation and access enforcement that demand immediate patching across cloud, on-premises, and IoT environments.
ai.summary_zh: 今日漏洞态势主要由Web安全与网络设备生态系统主导，呈现远程代码执行、认证绕过及内存破坏漏洞高发的特征。关键弱点波及广泛部署的系统，包括Kubernetes代理、WordPress插件、MB Connect Line医疗基础设施及多种数据库中间件组件，致使未认证攻击者可实施提权或外泄敏感数据。注入攻击、授权管控失效及安全凭据处理不当等频发模式，凸显了系统在输入验证与访问控制方面的深层缺陷，亟需在云端、本地部署及物联网环境中立即完成补丁修复。

items.reason_en: Allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via malicious OGM file parsing, requiring only minimal user interaction.
items.reason_zh: 允许远程攻击者通过解析恶意OGM文件执行任意代码，仅需极少的用户交互。

items.reason_en: Malicious monitors can exploit EDID descriptor handling to crash the X server or achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 恶意显示器可利用EDID描述符处理机制导致X服务器崩溃或实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A TOCTOU flaw enables local low-privileged attackers to escalate to code execution on Windows desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: TOCTOU缺陷使本地低权限攻击者能够在Windows桌面环境中提升权限以实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: pam_usb incorrectly detects remote tmux sessions using an outdated command, potentially bypassing hardware-based authentication policies on Linux workstations.
items.reason_zh: pam_usb使用过时命令错误检测远程tmux会话，可能导致绕过Linux工作站上的基于硬件的认证策略。

items.reason_en: Insecure direct object reference in Dolibarr allows authenticated users to access and view other users' sensitive expense report payment data.
items.reason_zh: Dolibarr中的不直接对象引用漏洞允许已认证用户访问并查看其他用户的敏感报销单支付数据。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization guards in Firekylin permit editor-role users to query and extract administrator TOTP secrets and cloud storage credentials.
items.reason_zh: Firekylin中不当的授权校验机制允许编辑角色用户查询并提取管理员TOTP密钥和云存储凭据。

items.reason_en: Enables remote attackers to achieve full device compromise via a stack-based buffer overflow in the authentication CGI.
items.reason_zh: 允许远程攻击者通过身份验证CGI中的栈缓冲区溢出实现设备完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Allows remote code execution through an out-of-bounds write in the mini_httpd component during web interface setup.
items.reason_zh: 允许在Web界面配置期间通过mini_httpd组件中的越界写入实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Firmware upgrade handler lacks sufficient verification, permitting attackers to flash malicious images remotely.
items.reason_zh: 固件升级处理程序缺乏充分验证，允许攻击者远程刷入恶意镜像。

items.reason_en: High-privileged code injection in the MB Connect Line backup restore function leads to complete system compromise of medical device infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: MB Connect Line备份恢复功能中存在高权限代码注入漏洞，可导致医疗设备基础设施的系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Weak static passwords protecting backup archives on MB Connect Line devices allow unauthenticated remote attackers to exfiltrate sensitive patient data.
items.reason_zh: MB Connect Line设备上保护备份归档文件的弱静态密码允许未认证的远程攻击者窃取敏感患者数据。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication enforcement in the SourceCodester Smart Attendance System API allows unauthorized manipulation of QR code scanner operations.
items.reason_zh: SourceCodester Smart Attendance System API中未强制执行身份验证，允许未经授权地操纵二维码扫描器操作。

items.reason_en: Authenticated organization members can inject shell commands via the serviceName parameter, leading to complete system compromise.
items.reason_zh: 已认证的组织成员可通过serviceName参数注入Shell命令，导致系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Kubernetes special agent argument injection allows rule editors to write arbitrary files and execute code on monitored hosts.
items.reason_zh: Kubernetes专用代理参数注入漏洞允许规则编辑器在受监控主机上写入任意文件并执行代码。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in synthetic monitoring tests enables attackers to define arbitrary HTML file contents and locations.
items.reason_zh: 合成监控测试中的路径遍历漏洞使攻击者能够定义任意HTML文件的内容和位置。

items.reason_en: HarnessRouter fails to enforce workspace scoping for API keys, allowing lateral movement and unauthorized access across isolated workspaces.
items.reason_zh: HarnessRouter未能对API密钥实施工作区范围限制，允许在隔离的工作区间进行横向移动和未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Debug logging in the zizmor CI/CD analysis tool inadvertently serializes and exposes sensitive environment credentials like GitHub tokens.
items.reason_zh: zizmor CI/CD分析工具中的调试日志记录意外序列化并暴露了GitHub令牌等敏感环境凭据。

items.reason_en: Aptabase uses a publicly known example AUTH_SECRET, enabling unauthenticated sign-in link forgery and user enumeration.
items.reason_zh: Aptabase使用了公开已知的示例AUTH_SECRET，导致未认证的攻击者可伪造登录链接并枚举用户。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary OS commands via crafted HA join-request packets without any credentials.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的攻击者可通过构造的HA加入请求数据包执行任意操作系统命令，无需任何凭据。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution by manipulating restricted directory paths.
items.reason_zh: 路径遍历漏洞允许通过操纵受限目录路径实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection enables unauthenticated attackers to extract sensitive data or execute administrative commands.
items.reason_zh: 盲SQL注入漏洞使未认证的攻击者能够提取敏感数据或执行管理命令。

items.reason_en: [CISA KEV] Local authenticated users exploit a world-writable socket to execute commands as root, widely exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: [CISA KEV] 本地已认证用户利用全局可写套接字以root权限执行命令，该漏洞已在野外被广泛利用。

items.reason_en: [CISA KEV] IRCv3 label injection allows server-to-server command execution with elevated authority across linked networks.
items.reason_zh: [CISA KEV] IRCv3标签注入漏洞允许跨关联网络以更高权限执行服务器间命令。

items.reason_en: AsyncSSH relies on insufficient path normalization, allowing SFTP clients to traverse outside intended directories via crafted relative paths.
items.reason_zh: AsyncSSH依赖的路径规范化不足，导致SFTP客户端可通过构造的相对路径遍历到预期目录之外。

items.reason_en: A heap buffer overflow in Ettercap can be triggered by malformed Gadu-Gadu protocol traffic, potentially crashing the sniffer or executing code.
items.reason_zh: Ettercap中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可由格式错误的Gadu-Gadu协议流量触发，可能导致嗅探器崩溃或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in NASA JPL ION-DTN's datagram retransmission layer allows heap corruption via maliciously crafted 64-bit length values.
items.reason_zh: NASA JPL ION-DTN的数据报重传层存在整数溢出漏洞，可通过恶意构造的64位长度值导致堆损坏。

items.reason_en: BusyBox wget fails to validate FTP resume offsets against reported file sizes, creating an integer calculation error exploitable by malicious servers.
items.reason_zh: BusyBox wget未能根据报告的文件大小验证FTP续传偏移量，从而产生整数计算错误，可被恶意服务器利用。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass occurs by parsing LOGGED_IN_COOKIE without cryptographic signature verification, enabling account takeover.
items.reason_zh: 通过解析LOGGED_IN_COOKIE而未经过加密签名验证可实现身份验证绕过，从而导致账户接管。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks on upload endpoints allow arbitrary file writes, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 上传端点缺失授权检查允许任意文件写入，可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Insufficient permission validation in delegated administration allows technicians to escalate privileges and trigger RCE.
items.reason_zh: 委派管理中不足的权限验证允许技术人员提权并触发远程代码执行(RCE)。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in the WordPress plugin allows attackers to extract database contents without direct query feedback.
items.reason_zh: 该WordPress插件中的盲SQL注入漏洞允许攻击者在无直接查询反馈的情况下提取数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Insufficient path validation in image optimization functions permits arbitrary file deletion, disrupting website assets.
items.reason_zh: 图像优化函数中的路径验证不充分，可导致任意文件删除，从而破坏网站资源。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization bypass in a widely used WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to reset passwords and fully compromise websites.
items.reason_zh: 某广泛使用的WordPress插件中存在严重的授权绕过漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者重置密码并完全控制网站。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated deserialization of untrusted data in rConfig enables arbitrary code execution via its Redis-backed job queue.
items.reason_zh: rConfig中未认证的不可信数据反序列化漏洞可通过其基于Redis的作业队列实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: OpenObserve accepts empty or whitespace-only passwords for certain accounts, granting unauthenticated access to cloud-native observability dashboards.
items.reason_zh: OpenObserve允许某些账户使用空密码或仅含空白字符的密码，从而导致攻击者可未授权访问云原生可观测性仪表板。

items.reason_en: A multitenancy permission check bypass in SuperTokens allows attackers to create or update resources outside their authorized tenant scope.
items.reason_zh: SuperTokens中的多租户权限检查绕过漏洞允许攻击者在超出其授权租户范围的情况下创建或更新资源。

items.reason_en: Novu passes unsanitized webhook URLs directly to HTTP clients, enabling SSRF attacks and potential internal network reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: Novu将未经过滤的Webhook URL直接传递给HTTP客户端，从而引发SSRF攻击及潜在的内部网络探测风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in pltcl allows object creators to execute arbitrary code as the database operating system user.
items.reason_zh: pltcl中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许对象创建者以数据库操作系统用户的身份执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Integer wraparound in memory context generation enables arbitrary code execution via oversized allocation reuse.
items.reason_zh: 内存上下文生成过程中的整数回绕漏洞可通过超大分配的重用实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Untrusted data inclusion in pg_dump tar restores allows compromised servers to execute code on client machines.
items.reason_zh: pg_dump tar还原操作中若包含不可信数据，可使受感染服务器在客户端机器上执行代码。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in logical replication permits compromised publishers to run commands as superuser-owned subscriptions.
items.reason_zh: 逻辑复制中缺失的授权检查允许被攻陷的发布者以超级用户订阅的身份执行命令。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in rabbitmq-c occurs when serializing oversized AMQP frames, posing a remote code execution risk to message broker clients.
items.reason_zh: rabbitmq-c在序列化超大AMQP帧时发生堆缓冲区溢出，对消息代理客户端构成远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Repeated failed GSSAPI authentication requests in MIT Kerberos allocate unreleased client state, enabling remote denial-of-service against directory services.
items.reason_zh: MIT Kerberos中重复失败的GSSAPI认证请求会分配未释放的客户端状态，从而可对目录服务发起远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: AIOHTTP's WebSocket reader retains excessive memory objects during incomplete frame reassembly, allowing malicious peers to trigger severe resource exhaustion.
items.reason_zh: AIOHTTP的WebSocket读取器在不完整的帧重组过程中会保留过多内存对象，使恶意端点能够触发严重的资源耗尽。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in limited-privilege accounts enables privilege escalation to root on the storage appliance.
items.reason_zh: 存储设备上低权限账户存在的OS命令注入漏洞可导致提权至root权限。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass vulnerability allows authenticated users to elevate privileges to administrator level.
items.reason_zh: 该授权绕过漏洞允许已认证用户将自身权限提升至管理员级别。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information leakage in log files during client initialization exposes configuration details to low-privileged attackers.
items.reason_zh: 客户端初始化期间日志文件中泄露的敏感信息会将配置细节暴露给低权限攻击者。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in FFmpeg's H.264 SEI parser can be exploited via crafted video streams to crash media players or backend transcoders.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg的H.264 SEI解析器中存在双重释放漏洞，攻击者可通过构造的视频流利用该漏洞导致媒体播放器或后端转码器崩溃。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Turboderp ExLlamaV3 AI routing kernel can be triggered by manipulated tensor arguments, risking information disclosure.
items.reason_zh: Turboderp ExLlamaV3 AI路由内核中的越界读取漏洞可由篡改的张量参数触发，存在信息泄露风险。

items.reason_en: The V programming language standard library defaults TLS certificate validation to false, enabling on-path attackers to intercept encrypted HTTPS traffic.
items.reason_zh: V编程语言标准库默认将TLS证书验证设置为false，使得中间人攻击者能够拦截加密的HTTPS流量。
